thread:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — thanks everyone for the fast triage. I pulled the remediation list into one place. Need concrete owners + short timelines for P0 items: blast-radius limiter, auto-rollback policy, canary sampling telemetry, post-deploy regression alerts, and runbook updates. Can folks claim items? Target: owners create GH issues and start PRs; P0s by EOD Fri.

Kevin O'Neill: I can take the auto-rollback policy. Proposal: two triggers — (1) 90th percentile latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR (2) error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. On trigger: immediate rollback + notify oncall + short cooldown. I'll draft an RFC and an ops playbook snippet.

Raj Patel: I'll prototype a blast limiter. Plan is scoped whitelists per-flag, plus a global "max rollout %" and a downstream-error cap that clamps traffic back to safe baseline. Will try a PoC by Wed.

Sarah L.: I'll own the canary sampling telemetry and dashboard. We'll add: per-flag sample size, request surface breakdown, top-10 regressions, and codepath parity checks. Will wire alerts for drift > 5% in key signals.

Taylor Nguyen: I'll handle CI/gating changes and the runbook edits. Add a CI check that refuses flag-rollouts > X% without a signed-off canary job. I'll also add a checklist for feature teams to attach a canary eval.

Maya Chen: Awesome. Please add GH issue links in this thread when created. For timelines: Kevin (auto-rollback) -> RFC + PR by Thu EOD; Raj (blast limiter) -> PoC PR by Wed; Sarah (telemetry) -> dashboard skeleton by Thu; Taylor (CI + runbook) -> PR by Fri. If anyone needs more time call it out now.

Kevin O'Neill: Draft policy snippet (will refine in RFC):

```json
{"auto_rollback": {"latency_pct": 90, "multiplier": 2, "windows": 3, "error_rate_pct": 1, "error_window_mins": 5, "actions": ["rollback", "notify_oncall", "quarantine_route"]}}
```

Raj Patel: quick note on blast limiter behavior — want to clamp using exponential backoff if downstream errors spike, not just a hard stop. Also will add a safety flag to force-full-rollback for SRE. Putting up a design doc later today.

ops-bot: Reminder: "Canary & flags sync" meeting Fri 10:30 AM (calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1234). Please RSVP.

Sarah L.: Adding alert names we should create: CANARY_DRIFT_HIGH, FLAG_PARITY_FAIL, AUTO_ROLLBACK_TRIGGER. I'll list exact query defs in the GH issue.

Taylor Nguyen: I'll update the rollout playbook section with explicit owner handoffs and a 1hr post-rollout verification window. Also adding small examples for rollback commands.

Maya Chen: Sounds great — thanks all. Action items recap: create GH issues, add assignees, set due dates (Thu/Fri as above). We'll reconvene after PRs to do a quick review. :thumbsup:

Kevin O'Neill: FYI I'll add unit tests for the policy evaluator and a simulation harness to validate thresholds against previous incidents.

Raj Patel: Putting the initial PR link here when ready.

Maya Chen: Perfect. If any blockers hit the owners, ping me directly. We'll surface any scope creep in the sync.

Sarah L.: :eyes: thanks, starting the dashboard wiring now.

ops-bot: Note: incident metrics export completed to /s3/incidents/2893456789 for forensic analysis.
